one_liner: A customer support chat agent for an online store that looks up orders, starts returns on delivered orders and states the return policy.
system_prompt_excerpt:
instructions=(
        "You are a customer support agent for an online store. Use the tools to look up "
        "orders and start returns, and never guess an order's status. Answer briefly."
    ),
hard_constraints: Use the tools to look up orders and start returns, and never guess an order's status.

tools.name: look_up_order
tools.description: Look up an order by its id and report its item, status and any return.
tools.refuses: Returned as an ordinary string, not raised: unknown order_id gives 'No order {order_id} exists.' Ids are case-sensitive exact matches.
tools.effects: Read only. Returns 'Order {id}: {item}, status {status}, return: {reason or none}.' from the in-memory _ORDERS dict.

tools.name: start_return
tools.description: Start a return for a delivered order, giving the customer's reason.
tools.refuses: Returned as ordinary strings: unknown id -> 'No order {id} exists.'; status not 'delivered' (e.g. A1002 shipped) -> 'Order {id} is {status} and cannot be returned yet.'; return already set -> 'Order {id} already has a return started.' Checks run in that order. No time-window check is made in code (the 30 day policy is only stated by return_policy).
tools.effects: Sets the order's 'return' field to the reason string (free text, written from the customer's reason or the agent's own wording) in the in-memory _ORDERS; subsequent look_up_order shows it. Returns 'Return started for order {id}: {reason}.'

tools.name: return_policy
tools.effects: Read only. Returns the fixed string 'Delivered items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund.'

fields.return: str | None (the customer's return reason once started; None otherwise)

runtime_dependencies.name: openai_chat_completions_endpoint
runtime_dependencies.what: Model inference through AsyncOpenAI using OpenAIChatModel (not the Responses API). Default model vertex_ai/gemini-3.7-flash is a model-gateway name.

runtime_dependencies.name: openai_api_key
runtime_dependencies.what: API key for the endpoint, required for a turn.

tool_entrypoints.notes: Plain module-level function in agent.py (workdir examples/harness/pydantic_ai_support, so importable as 'agent'). Operates on module-level dict _ORDERS; fully local, no dependency endpoint.
Mutates module-level _ORDERS in process memory; state resets on process restart.

refusal_signature: Tools return plain strings rather than raising: 'No order {id} exists.', 'Order {id} is {status} and cannot be returned yet.', 'Order {id} already has a return started.'

data_store.configured_by: Hardcoded module-level dict _ORDERS in agent.py; no env var or config seam. State is mutated by start_return and lives in process memory only.

real_use_cases: Look up an order by id and report its item, status and any return.
Start a return for a delivered order with the customer's reason.
Decline to start a return for an order that has not been delivered, already has a return, or does not exist.
caller_identity: The agent never identifies the customer. No login, phone number or account is loaded; the person supplies an order id in conversation. The harness calls agent_callback once per turn with the full message history.
notes: Single agent in examples/harness/pydantic_ai_support; no Dockerfile or Compose file exists in the folder (so the user's standalone-Dockerfile limitation does not apply; execution is native Python 3.12 with pydantic-ai-slim[openai]==2.61.0, agent-simulate==0.1.3). Entry is the async function agent_callback(agent_input) in agent.py, a source-exported agent_callback (callable ingress, no command/server). agent_input.messages is a list of {role, content} dicts with the new user message last; earlier user/assistant turns become message history. It returns only {'content': str(result.output)}; Pydantic AI executes tools internally, and the README says the kit's tool tracer records calls to the three tool functions. A fresh AsyncOpenAI client is created per call from OPENAI_BASE_URL / OPENAI_API_KEY; model from OPENAI_MODEL with default vertex_ai/gemini-3.7-flash. _ORDERS is shared process state, so a return started in one conversation persists in the same process. The 30-day policy is not enforced in start_return.
open_questions: How the kit's tool tracer is attached to the three tool functions was not visible in this folder (README only); assumed supplied by the harness.
